title: Compact-source slices in an accessible infinity category
statement: Use the universes, smallness, compactness and filteredness of [def-coef-presentable-infinity-category] and the coherent functors, mapping spaces and colimits of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones]. Let $\kappa$ be an infinite regular cardinal in the smaller universe, let $\mathcal C$ be a $\kappa$-accessible quasicategory, and let $D\subseteq\mathcal C$ be the replete full subcategory of all $\kappa$-compact objects. Then $D$ is essentially small. For each $x\in\mathcal C$, the coherent slice $\mathcal C_{/x}$ has arrows $c\to x$ as objects and commuting triangles over the identity of x as morphisms, retaining all higher coherent homotopies. Define $D_{/x}$ to be its full subcategory on arrows $d\to x$ with $d\in D$. Then $D_{/x}$ is essentially small and $\kappa$-filtered. Its source projection $D_{/x}\to D\hookrightarrow\mathcal C$, with the tautological cocone to $x$, is a colimit diagram. Colimits indexed by $D_{/x}$ mean colimits after passage to a small equivalent quasicategory.
